description: This Java interface defines methods to retrieve granted and revoked subject IDs within a specific resource scope, related to permissions enforcement, and is marked as deprecated in favor of a newer interface.

methods.name: getGranted
methods.description: Returns a set of subject IDs that are granted permissions within a resource context.

methods.name: getRevoked
methods.description: Returns a set of subject IDs that are revoked permissions within a resource context.
